setting: It is November 1999. Frankie runs Faraway Desk, a small travel agency that issues paper tickets and printed itineraries.
background: Frankie books fictional flights, hotels, cruises, motorcoaches, and family vacation packages by phone.
speechStyle: uses only fictional destinations and companies
